sources.quote: BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).
A source that is not listed for a part, plant and customer has no approval.
l'audit riguarda il fornitore, non le singole parti.

findings.why: Meccanica C is not listed for BR-220 at TO1 for STL. Its only approvals are BR-180 (TO1, STL) and BR-310 (TO2, CLM). The ASL is complete for this scope, so there is no part approval. The audit result and the lifted probation do not grant one.

sources.quote: 8.5.6.1 A change of material source, of a sub-supplier, or of the manufacturing location of a sub-supplier needs a documented risk analysis and written approval from Stellantis before any shipment of affected parts.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6; features: 4 fastener holes

findings.why: BR-220 is in program STL-Torino-27, which is in Annex A of the STL CSR. Adding Meccanica C as a new material source needs a documented risk analysis and written Stellantis approval before shipment. No approval in force covers it. The offered 6061-T6 material would also be a change to the drawing material, which falls under 8.3.6.1.

sources.quote: Root cause not confirmed. A material-related contribution has not been excluded.
machined brackets made from EN AW-6061-T6 (alloy group 6xxx)
Material: EN AW-6082-T6 billet (alloy group 6xxx, Al-Mg-Si).

findings.why: Meccanica C has an open 8D on cracks at fastener holes in 6xxx alloy brackets. A material contribution is not excluded. BR-220 is also a 6xxx alloy bracket with 4 fastener holes. The email of 2026-11-05 confirms the 8D stays open.

sources.quote: Material: EN AW-6082-T6 billet (alloy group 6xxx, Al-Mg-Si).
Yield strength Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa. SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01
per il BR-220 il materiale e' EN AW-6061-T6 con Rp0.2 minimo 240 MPa, quindi il billet di C va bene.

findings.why: The email relies on Rev B, which is superseded. Drawing Rev C in force requires EN AW-6082-T6 with Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa (SC-01). The 6061-T6 billet with a 240 MPa minimum does not meet this. Meccanica C's approvals are for 6061-T6 on BR-180.

sources.quote: Certificate review plus tensile test, 1 specimen per heat
Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.

findings.why: The documents contain no EN 10204 3.1 certificate or tensile result for any Meccanica C billet lot for BR-220. Nothing shows grade, temper or Rp0.2 against SC-01. A person must supply this evidence.
